player_prompt.intro:
Tirid 2048 ɣef ussida {board_size}x{board_size}. Ifuk inuɣen a k-awḍeḍ i tajṛa {target_tile} s usragl n imzalayen idrusen!
Imussugen imseflalen: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tijṛiwin ttekkin mi ara kkin, tettekkin aḥric-nsent.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Aks n takti ur igi. Sken '[Up]'/'[Down]'/'[Left]'/'[Right]'.
invalid_move.no_change: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⵓⵙⵇⵇⵉⵎ - ⵙⵜⴰⵢ ⵢⴰⵏ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵢⴰⴹⵏ.

outcome.lose: Ur sul imussugen. Tajṛa tamqrant {max_tile} - timsal aneggaru {score}.
